title: Ethiopia Statutory Tax & Payroll Pack (2026)
description: Standard Ethiopian statutory rules for VAT, domestic withholding, corporate tax, POESSA pensions, and PAYE tax brackets. Flagged values require verification by a licensed accountant.

rules.name: Value Added Tax (VAT)
rules.notes: Proclamation 1341/2024; registration threshold ETB 2,000,000 over 12 consecutive months; exports of IT services zero-rated (0%). Added on top of quote price.

rules.name: Corporate Profit Tax
rules.notes: Standard 30% corporate income tax rate on taxable project profits. Estimated in internal owner view only.

rules.name: Domestic Withholding Tax on Services
rules.notes: Conflicting sources: 3% standard rate on payments for domestic services. Rate increases to 30% if supplier has no TIN or valid business license. Threshold reported as ETB 10,000 by some sources. Cash-flow deduction, not a direct agency cost.

rules.name: POESSA Employer Pension
rules.notes: 11% statutory employer contribution calculated on basic salary for Ethiopian nationals. Foreign nationals are exempt. Configurable base (basic vs gross) and ceiling in settings.

rules.name: POESSA Employee Pension Withholding
rules.notes: 7% statutory deduction withheld from employee salary. Not an employer cost.

rules.name: Personal Income Tax (PAYE) Progressive Brackets
rules.notes: Reformed income tax schedule. Tax-free floor is ETB 2,000/month (200,000 santim). Brackets progress from 0% to 35%. Borne by employee, not added to company cost. Conflicting sources on exact intermediate tier thresholds.

rules.name: Severance Pay Provision Accrual
rules.notes: Labour Proclamation 1156/2019 provision. Standard severance accrual ~1 month per year of service (~8.33%). Optional provision, disabled by default.

rules.name: Digital Services Tax (DST)
rules.notes: Watch item: New tax on digital services pending ministerial directive and regulations. Set to inactive by default.
